top_news.title: National Health Leaders Call for Coordinated Action to Accelerate Cervical Cancer Elimination in India
top_news.summary: India's pathway towards cervical cancer elimination requires more than screening and vaccination alone. It calls for accessible technologies, reliable treatment pathways, sustained financing, and coordinated action across government, healthcare, research, industry, and communities. This was the central message emerging from a two-day national dialogue series held on 15 and 16 September 2026, bringing together stakeholders from medical societies, public health, research, government, technology, international organisations, and civil society to build consensus on accelerating cervical cancer elimination in India. Organised by Cancer Awareness Prevention and Early Detection (CAPED) Trust, in collaboration with NCI-AIIMS, ICMR-NICPR, with the Cervical Cancer Elimination Consortium-India (CCEC-I) as a supporting partner, the first day was a dialogue on strengthening HPV DNA-based screening, improving access to treatment, expanding vaccination. The second day was a national high-level round table organized by CAPED, the Global HPV Consortium (GHC), and CCEC-I, to create a call to action translating national policy into action at the state and community level. The dialogue brought together several distinguished experts and stakeholders, including Shri. Pushpendra Rajput, Joint Secretary, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India; Dr. Shalini Singh, Dr. Showket Hussain, and Dr. Ruchika Gupta from ICMR-NICPR, New Delhi; Dr. Radhika A.G. from the Directorate of Family Welfare, New Delhi; Sripriya Rao (Co-Founder & Chief Growth Officer, Karkinos Healthcare); Dr. Neerja Bhatla, Professor & Ex-HOD, Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology and Professor Emeritus, National Cancer Institute-AIIMS, New Delhi; Dr. Pranay Tanwar, Dr. Seema Singhal, and Dr. Hari Sagiraju from NCI-AIIMS; Dr. Saritha ShyamSundar, HOD, Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi; Prof. Karen Canfell, (Cancer Elimination Collaboration, University of Sydney, and Lead, Elimination Partnership in Cervical Cancer (EPICC); Prof. Sanjay Dhir from IIT Delhi; and many other respected experts and stakeholders. top_news.title: White Pine Copper Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study to Revive One of America
top_news.summary: Post-Tax NPV8% of US$1.38 Billion and 23.1% IRR Position White Pine North as a Major New Source of Domestic Copper Supply and Regional Jobs KEY PFS HIGHLIGHTS Post-tax net present value ("NPV") at an 8% discount rate of US$1,376.9 million and internal rate of return ("IRR") of 23.1%; pre-tax NPV8%of US$1,783.1 million and IRR of 26.2%. Post-tax payback period of 3.4 years from the start of production; and pre-tax payback period of 3.1 years. Initial capital cost of US$905.5 million, representing a post-tax NPV-to-initial-capex ratio of approximately 1.5x. Mineral Resource Estimate of 191.2 million tonnes at 1.62% copper (Indicated: 169.1 Mt at 1.64% Cu and 20.66 g/t Ag; Inferred: 22.1 Mt at 1.51% Cu and 22.66 g/t Ag) Mineral Resources are reported inclusive of Mineral Reserves. Mineral Reserves are derived from the Indicated Mineral Resource after application of the relevant mining and economic factors. Reserve-supported, 26 year mine plan: probable Mineral Reserve of 137.9 million tonnes; steady-state production of 5.4 million ore tonnes per year and more than 45,000 tonnes of payable copper per year. No Inferred Mineral Resources are included in the PFS economic analysis. By-product cash cost of US$1.44/lb copper and all-in sustaining cost of US$2.32/lb copper. White Pine Copper's estimated steady-state AISC, normalized to Wood Mackenzie's 2026 cost curve assumptions, falls within the first quartile of the US subset of the Copper Cost Curve. Brownfield restart, and planned reuse of existing tailings storage infrastructure in Michigan's historic White Pine copper district, which produced approximately 4.5 billion pounds of copper between 1953 and 1995. All major permit applications have been submitted for review by the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy ("EGLE"). Conventional modified room-and-pillar underground mining and a conventional crush-grind-flotation plant, with copper and silver recoveries of 85.6% and 96.0%, respectively, into a clean, low-penalty concentrate yielding 26.2% copper and 451 g/t silver. WPC targets a Final Investment Decision in the second half of 2027 and commercial production in 2030. TORONTO and WHITE PINE, Mich., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- White Pine Copper LLC ("WPC" or the "Company"), a Michigan-based copper development company wholly owned by Kinterra Copper USA LLC("Kinterra"), is pleased to announce the results of a Pre-Feasibility Study ("PFS") for its White Pine North Project ("White Pine North" or the "Project") located in Michigan, USA. All dollar amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated. The PFS outlines a technically and economically robust plan to redevelop the historic White Pine copper district as a modern underground mining operation. The plan is supported by an extensive drilling database, a Probable Mineral Reserve, positive metallurgical testwork, and a well-established, state-only permitting framework. Copper was added to the U.S. Geological Survey's Critical Minerals List for the first time in 2025, as net U.S. import reliance for refined copper has climbed above 40% of consumption. Demand for copper in the United States is expected to grow substantially over the coming decade, driven by electrification, grid modernization and the build-out of domestic manufacturing capacity. White Pine North would rank among the largest new sources of domestically mined copper in the country, and its redevelopment is expected to bring significant employment and economic activity back to a part of Michigan's Upper Peninsula that has experienced sustained economic decline since the historic White Pine Mine closed in 1995. MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY "White Pine North is exactly the kind of asset the U.S. copper market needs right now: a large, high-grade deposit in one of the best-understood copper districts in North America, with a clear and capital-efficient path to production. Domestic demand for copper is climbing at the same time domestic supply has been shrinking, and we believe White Pine North can become one of the largest new sources of American-mined copper." said Cheryl Brandon, Co-Founder of Kinterra. "This PFS is the product of an integrated technical program across resource definition, mine engineering, metallurgy and permitting, and it confirms what this district has always offered: a large, well-understood orebody that modern mining methods can extract efficiently. Just as important, it means jobs and economic activity coming back to a part of Michigan's Upper Peninsula that has waited a long time for it."said Chad Wolahan, Project Director at White Pine Copper LLC. MINERAL RESOURCE AND RESERVE The current Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") was prepared by Dahrouge Geological Consulting USA Ltd. ("Dahrouge") using a validated drillhole, geological, analytical and density database current as of June 5, 2026, and is reported at a cut-off grade of 0.90% Cu: Indicated: 169.1 Mt at 1.64% Cu and 20.66 g/t Ag, containing 2.77 Mt of copper Inferred: 22.1 Mt at 1.51% Cu and 22.66 g/t Ag, containing 0.33 Mt of copper Total: 191.2 Mt at 1.62% Cu and 20.89 g/t Ag, containing 3.11 Mt of copper This current MRE supersedes all prior historical estimates for the Project, including the 1995 CRC estimate and the 2019 and 2023 G Mining Services Inc. estimates, none of which should be relied upon. The Mineral Reserve, effective July 16, 2026, is classified entirely as Probable and totals 137.9 million tonnes at 1.04% Cu and 16.02 g/t Ag, containing approximately 3,171 million pounds of copper and 71.0 million ounces of silver. The Reserve reflects a net smelter return cut-off grade specific to each mining area and an estimated mining dilution of 6% by volume at 100% mining recovery. PFS RESULTS SHOW ROBUST ECONOMICS The PFS financial model was developed on a 100%-equity, 100%-ownership basis with no financing costs assumed, applying long-term consensus commodity price assumptions of US$4.97/lb copper and US$53.69/oz silver and an 8% discount rate. Summary Financial Metrics Post-tax NPV (8% discount rate): US$1,376.9 million Post-tax IRR: 23.1% Post-tax payback period: approximately 3.4 years Pre-tax NPV (8% discount rate): US$1,783.1 million Pre-tax IRR: 26.2% Pre-tax payback period: approximately 3.1 years Initial capital cost: US$905.5 million Sustaining capital cost: US$863.0 million Closure capital cost: US$160.0 million Life-of-mine operating cost: US$5,952 million (or US$43.16 per tonne processed) By-product cash cost: US$1.44/lb Cu; by-product all-in sustaining cost ("AISC"): US$2.32/lb Cu Co-product cash cost: US$2.15/lb CuEq; co-product AISC: US$2.85/lb CuEq Mine life: 26 years Sensitivity analysis indicates the Project's economics are most sensitive to metal price, head grade and recovery, and less sensitive to operating and initial capital costs. MINE PLAN AND DEVELOPMENT White Pine North will be mined using a modified room-and-pillar method with no backfill, well suited to the deposit's relatively flat-lying geometry and enabling high equipment utilization and predictable production rates. The mine is designed for steady-state production of 15,000 tonnes per day (5.4 Mt/y), accessed via declines expanding from two to four over the life of mine, with ore delivered to surface via a truck-and-conveyor material handling system. Over the life of mine, total ore mined is estimated at 137.9 Mt at an average grade of 1.04% Cu, containing approximately 3,171 million pounds of copper. METALLURGY AND PROCESSING Metallurgical testwork completed between 2024 and 2026 at Intertek's Base Metals Laboratory in Kamloops, BC, supports a conventional processing route comprising crushing, SAG and ball mill grinding, gravity concentration, and flotation. The process is expected to achieve copper and silver recoveries of 85.6% and 96.0%, respectively, producing a clean copper concentrate grading approximately 26.2% Cu and 451 g/t Ag, with low deleterious-element content. PERMITTING AND LOCATION White Pine North is located in Ontonagon County in Michigan's Upper Peninsula, within the historic White Pine copper district, which produced approximately 4.5 billion pounds of copper between 1953 and 1995 before operations were suspended. The Project is a brownfield redevelopment that will reuse the site's existing tailings storage infrastructure, reducing its environmental footprint relative to a greenfield development. All major permit applications have been submitted for regulatory review and fall under the jurisdiction of the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes and Energypursuant to the Michigan Natural Resources and Environmental Protection Act. The Project requires no federal permits as it involves no federal lands, minerals, or other nexus that would trigger the National Environmental Policy Act. All baseline environmental, archeological and hydrogeological studies have been completed and WPC has engaged with local governments, community groups and Native American communities throughout Project development. PROJECT SCHEDULE WPC has commenced a Feasibility Study targeted for completion by mid-2027, with a Final Investment Decision targeted for H2 2027 and commercial production targeted for 2030, reflecting an estimated 30-month construction period following Final Investment Decision. ABOUT WHITE PINE COPPER LLC White Pine Copper LLC is a Michigan-based copper development company advancing the White Pine North Project in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. www.whitepinecu.com. ABOUT KINTERRA CAPITAL Kinterra Capital is a private equity firm that invests in the people, ideas, critical materials, and strategic infrastructure necessary to accelerate the development of the modern economy. With nearly 20 years of mining investment experience, Kinterra leverages significant domain specific technical and transactional expertise to source and manage investments that create value for its stakeholders, all while supporting the communities within which we operate through meaningful partnerships. At Kinterra, we focus on creative ideation, rigorous analysis and executing with excellence to make investments that will create sustainable, strong and secure supply chains. For more information about Kinterra Capital, please visit www.kinterracapital.com. TECHNICAL CONSULTANTS The scientific and technical information in this press release relating to the MRE is based on, and fairly represents, information prepared under the supervision of Paul Richardson, M.Sc., RM-SME, an employee of Dahrouge, which is independent of the Company. Mr. Richardson is a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101 and has reviewed and approved the mineral resource information contained in this press release. The technical data, engineering designs, and cost estimates supporting the Pre-Feasibility Study were prepared by experienced, independent consulting firms under the oversight of the Company and relevant subject matter experts. The consulting firms and their respective areas of contribution to the Pre-Feasibility Study are outlined below. Ausenco Engineering Canada ULC: Process flowsheet, process plant and surface ancillary infrastructure design; overall cost estimates, financial model and PFS compilation. Dahrouge Geological Consulting USA Ltd.:Geology modeling and MRE. Foth Infrastructure & Environment, LLC:Environmental studies and permitting, water balance and water management. Stantec Consulting Services Inc.:Underground mine design and engineering, including the mine planning and modifying factors used to support declaration of the Probable Mineral Reserve. WSP USA Inc.: Underground geotechnical programs and design criteria. Tetra Tech, Inc.: Tailings disposal facilities design and hydrology modeling. SRK Consulting (U.S.), Inc.: Geochemical programs. Paterson & Cooke USA, Ltd.:Tailings thickening and tailings pumping systems. CAUTIONARY NOTE REGARDING THE PRE-FEASIBILITY STUDY The PFS is preliminary in nature. Mineral Reserves have been estimated in accordance with the CIM Definition Standards for Mineral Resources and Mineral Reserves and are supported entirely by Indicated Mineral Resources; no Inferred Mineral Resources have been included in the Mineral Reserve estimate or in the PFS economic analysis. There is no certainty that the PFS results will be realized. These statements are based on current expectations, estimates, projections, and assumptions that are subject to a range of known and unknown risks and uncertainties, many of which are beyond the control of WPC and Kinterra. top_news.summary: The Indian Micro-Fertilizers Manufacturers Association (IMMA) has called for a "One Nation, One License" digital framework for fertilizer licensing, freer exports of non-subsidised Made-in-India specialty fertilizers and micronutrients, and a uniform 5% GST for all FCO-notified plant nutrition products. Industry-government roundtable discusses digital licensing, FCO reforms, export facilitation, anti-counterfeiting and GST rationalisation. The proposals were discussed at the 3rd IMMA Industry-Government Roundtable held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, which brought together senior Government representatives and stakeholders from the micronutrient, specialty fertilizer and plant nutrition industry. The deliberations focused on ease of doing business and regulatory reforms, export facilitation and global market access, and GST rationalisation, with industry and Government representatives discussing specific measures that could be taken forward through evidence-backed submissions. 'One Nation, One License' digital framework proposed Opening the first session, Dr Rahul Mirchandani, President, IMMA, urged the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare to consider developing a national digital fertilizer licensing data stack to simplify the process of obtaining and renewing manufacturing licences and state marketing permissions. Under the proposed framework, manufacturers could upload corporate, manufacturing, product, technical, statutory and other licence-related documents once on a secure national digital platform. After digital verification by the competent authorities, the authenticated documents could be used for applications across states instead of companies repeatedly submitting the same documents. top_news.title: Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus Now Open - 미주 한국일보
top_news.summary: • Six-Building Expansion Brings Specialized Hospital and Outpatient Care Together on One Integrated Campus • Dedicated Cancer, Women’s Health, Digestive Health and Surgical Facilities Expand Access to Advanced Care in Orange County IRVINE, Calif. (Sept. 21, 2026) – Hoag today announced the opening of the Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus, a major expansion that brings specialized hospitals, outpatient facilities, advanced surgical services and nationally recognized clinical programs together on one integrated campus in Irvine.“This expansion is more than a collection of state-of-the-art buildings. It reflects Hoag’s commitment to growing alongside Orange County, while continuing to redefine what healthcare can look like,” said Robert T. Braithwaite, President & CEO of Hoag. “The Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus was envisioned as a healthcare village, bringing specialized care and clinical expertise together in a place where every aspect of the patient experience was designed to make care more connected, more convenient, and more personalized.”A New Chapter in IrvineHoag Hospital Irvine first opened in 2010, extending Hoag’s hospital-based care into one of Orange County’s fastest-growing communities. In the years since, Hoag has continued to expand its presence in Irvine alongside the community it serves, adding new services, specialists and facilities to meet growing and increasingly complex healthcare needs.The opening of the Sun Family Campus marks the next chapter in that evolution, building on Hoag Hospital Irvine’s strong foundation with a significant expansion of advanced specialty care. The campus brings together dedicated facilities for cancer, women’s health, digestive health and advanced surgery, along with emergency and orthopedic care. Across Sand Canyon Avenue, additional Hoag outpatient facilities offer primary care, urgent care, imaging, physician offices and specialty services, creating a connected destination where patients can access care across a broad range of needs.Designed Around PatientsThe campus was designed to make that care easier to navigate and the experience of receiving it less stressful. Hospital and outpatient services are connected to reduce friction as patients move through diagnosis, treatment and recovery, while the physical environment reflects the same attention to the patient experience.Natural light, landscaped outdoor spaces, intuitive wayfinding, welcoming gathering areas and amenities for patients and families are integrated throughout the campus to promote comfort, connection and healing. Together with a care model that brings specialists and services closer to patients, these elements create an environment designed around both the clinical and human needs of patients and families.“We had the rare opportunity to build around the patient experience from the ground up,” said Robert Brunswick, Chair of the Hoag Hospital Board of Directors. “That meant thinking not only about the medicine and technology inside these buildings, but also about how patients and families move through them, how they stay connected to their care teams, and how the environment itself can support them during some of the most important moments of their lives.”Women’s HealthHoag’s new Women’s Hospital and Women’s Outpatient Pavilion bring together specialized care for women across every stage of life, from pregnancy and childbirth to breast health, gynecology, menopause and wellness.The Women’s Hospital features 24 private labor, delivery and postpartum suites, a 24/7 OB Emergency Department and a 17-bed Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) with private rooms designed to support families. Just steps away, the Women’s Outpatient Pavilion provides breast health, maternal-fetal diagnostics, OB-GYN and midwifery care, advanced imaging and wellness services, connecting care across different stages of a woman’s life.Cancer CareHoag’s cancer facilities bring specialized hospital and outpatient care together to make a complex cancer journey more coordinated and convenient. The Cancer Outpatient Pavilion brings oncology specialists, infusion therapy, imaging, pharmacy and supportive services together in one location, while a Cancer Hospital just steps away provides dedicated inpatient rooms for patients undergoing cancer treatment.The campus is also home to Orange County’s first dedicated Cancer Urgent Care, providing evaluation and treatment for cancer-related symptoms and therapy-related side effects. Available to both Hoag and non-Hoag cancer patients, the service gives patients another option for timely, specialized care outside of a traditional emergency department.Digestive HealthHoag’s digestive health facilities bring together specialized physicians, advanced diagnostics, procedures and hospital care for patients with digestive conditions, creating a more connected path from diagnosis through treatment and recovery.The Digestive Outpatient Pavilion features six specialized procedure suites supporting advanced digestive health and interventional pulmonology care, with technology for minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment. From routine screenings to highly specialized procedures, these spaces allow physicians to identify and treat conditions while helping many patients recover more comfortably and return home the same day. Meanwhile, the adjacent Digestive Hospital provides dedicated rooms and specialized care teams for patients who need hospital-based care.Advanced Surgical ServicesThe Surgical Pavilion expands Hoag’s capabilities for complex surgery and critical care with eight state-of-the-art operating rooms, including a hybrid suite for highly complex cardiovascular and vascular procedures; advanced robotic-assisted technology; and minimally invasive surgical capabilities.The pavilion was designed to support coordination throughout the surgical experience, from preparation and surgery through recovery and critical care. Dedicated pre-operative and recovery areas, spacious intensive care rooms and amenities for families further reflect the campus’s focus on both clinical excellence and the patient experience.Community Investment Made Possible Through Philanthropy Philanthropy has been a cornerstone of Hoag’s growth since its earliest days, when community donations and a landmark gift from the Hoag family helped establish the flagship hospital in Newport Beach. Today, that tradition continues through the Boldly Hoag campaign, which fueled the expansion of the Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus. Thousands of community donors and partners have contributed to the expansion, along with transformational gifts that have accelerated the campus’s growth. These include $100 million from campus namesakes Diana and David Sun and $25 million from longtime Hoag supporters Benjamin and Carmela Du, whose gift established the Du Family Hospital Pavilion. “Philanthropy is one of the forces that makes Hoag’s privademic model possible, giving our physicians and clinical leaders the resources to move quickly, invest in innovation and build programs around what patients need,” said Caroline A. Pereira, MBA, president of the Hoag Hospital Foundation. “The Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus is an extraordinary example of what can happen when a community invests in its own health. Every donor who contributed to this vision helped create a place that will serve Orange County families for generations.”Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus at a Glance• $1 billion expansion • The expansion adds six new buildings to the hospital campus. • The expansion adds 155 inpatient beds to the campus, bringing the hospital’s total bed count to 251.• The expansion adds 11 operating rooms and two procedure rooms. • The expansion includes 120,000 square feet of ambulatory facilities • The project brings dedicated cancer, women’s health, digestive health and augmented surgical facilities to the campus.• The expansion builds upon the hospital’s existing 24/7 Emergency Department, inpatient medical care, and Hoag Orthopedic Institute, a nationally recognized orthopedic specialty hospital.• The Sun Family Campus includes Orange County’s first dedicated Cancer Urgent Care. • The new Women’s Hospital includes a 24/7 OB Emergency Department.• A 17-bed Level III NICU is part of the expansionABOUT HOAGHoag is a nonprofit, regional healthcare delivery system in Orange County, California. Delivering world-class, comprehensive, personalized care, Hoag consists of 1,800 top physicians, 17 urgent care facilities, 13 health & wellness centers, and two award-winning hospitals. Hoag offers a comprehensive blend of healthcare services that includes seven institutes providing specialized services in the following areas: cancer, digestive health, heart and vascular, neurosciences, spine, women’s health, and orthopedics through Hoag’s affiliate, Hoag Orthopedic Institute, which consists of an orthopedic hospital and five ambulatory surgical centers. Hoag is consistently named a best hospital by U.S. News & World Report, and is a designated Magnet® with Distinction hospital by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). For more information, visit hoag.org.

top_news.title: "BJP's Punjab conspiracy exposed": Sanjay Singh alleges drug trafficker Jagga was called 'Bhai' by BJP, being portrayed as revolutionary
top_news.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party on Monday alleged a conspiracy by the BJP, Shiromani Akali Dal and Congress to defame Punjab and undermine the Bhagwant Mann government's campaign against drugs. Senior party leader and Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh said Jagga Singh, whom the BJP has referred to as its bhai, has nine cases registered against him, including under the NDPS (Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances) Act, while eight cases are registered against Mohan Jeet Singh. Addressing a press conference at the AAP headquarters on Monday, Singh said that the BJP, Congress and Akali Dal are jointly hatching a deep conspiracy in Punjab. A complete conspiracy is being planned to defame the campaign being run by CM Bhagwant Mann and the AAP government against drugs in Punjab, weaken it, stop it, and ensure that Punjab is defamed across the world for drugs, he added. The AAP MP added, There are three characters in this conspiracy, Jagga Singh, Mohanjeet Singh and Gulzar Singh. The Congress, BJP and Akali Dal, without knowing the truth or conducting any investigation, are using these people and standing behind them to make bizarre statements and run campaigns against the AAP government. Sanjay Singh said that Jagga Singh, whom the BJP and Congress are presenting as a revolutionary and claiming was running a campaign against drugs and was forced to consume poison as a result, has nine cases registered against him. Jagga Singh has already been convicted in four of these nine cases, and cases of rape, kidnapping and drug trafficking are also registered against him, he added. He continued, Two gram panchayats had formally passed resolutions against drugs, because his business was unable to operate, as he himself had been involved in the drug trade. The Congress, BJP and Akali Dal are portraying him as a revolutionary and claiming that the government is harassing him. The AAP MP highlighted that the second person is Mohanjeet Singh, who had shown a black flag to Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. He said the Congress, BJP and Akali Dal are running a campaign claiming that this warrior fighting against drugs was brutally beaten merely for showing a black flag. The reality, he said, is that eight FIRs are registered against Mohanjeet Singh. The third name is Gulzar, about whom it was claimed that he took his own life because of Minister Harpal Singh Cheema. The reality is that opposition parties in Punjab kept making Gulzar record videos and drove him around in a car until he made a statement against the AAP. In the first video Gulzar recorded, he did not mention Harpal Singh Cheema or the AAP. However, in a subsequent video, he named Harpal Singh Cheema. This shows that opposition parties pressured and used him, which led to his present condition, Singh said. He said, I want to tell the Congress, BJP and Akali Dal not to indulge in such filthy politics and not to try to defame Punjab by making baseless and false allegations. The AAP government is running its campaign against drugs with complete commitment and is eliminating drugs. Sanjay Singh said that he was also aware of the period when drug mafias had links with leaders of the Akali Dal and BJP. He said the Akali Dal, BJP and Congress had together conducted the drug trade in Punjab and committed the sin of delivering drugs to every village. Sanjay Singh claimed that under the rule of these parties, the drug trade continued to flourish and governments provided protection to drug dealers. Punjab has also witnessed a period when, under the Akali Dal-BJP government, young children studying in high school and intermediate classes died because of drugs, he added. Drugs worth Rs 20,000 crore were seized at Adani's Mundra Port in BJP-ruled Gujarat. This was stated by the central government agency NIA. The NIA had approached the Supreme Court to oppose the bail of those arrested in connection with the drug trade. While opposing their bail, the NIA stated in an affidavit that the money from the drugs worth Rs 20,000 crore seized at Adani's port in Gujarat was spent on training terrorists in Pakistan, Singh said. The NIA has submitted a written affidavit before the Supreme Court opposing bail for the accused, stating that they should not be granted bail because they were very serious criminals and the money from the drugs was being used to train terrorists in Pakistan, the MP added. He noted, Gujarat has a liquor ban and alcohol is completely prohibited there, yet 100 people died after consuming poisonous liquor, while PM Narendra Modi and Nitin Nabin did not utter a single word. In neighbouring Uttar Pradesh, 105 people died after consuming poisonous liquor in Aligarh, but not a single BJP leader said a word. Therefore, he said, BJP leaders should not try to defame Punjab, because the entire country knows them and they will be exposed across the country. Singh concluded by highlighting that the Akali Dal, BJP and Congress have themselves run the largest drug trade in Punjab. If any party has genuinely taken action against it, he said, it is the AAP and the Bhagwant Mann government. If these parties want to speak openly about this issue, we will do so, but we will not allow them to defame Punjab. Those who themselves are disgraced and against whom cases of rape, kidnapping and drug trafficking are registered are being used by these parties for politics, with the parties standing behind them, he said. (ANI)

top_news.title: Gold Loans on the Rise as Indians Increasingly Borrow Against Gold
top_news.summary: For many years, gold has held important value as a store of wealth among Indian families. But with changing times, the mindset of people has changed. Due to which the, gold which was lying in lockers and cupboards has started being used to raise money. Gold loans are seeing rapid growth in India as there has been an increase in borrowers pledging jewellery to meet the funding requirements instead of selling it. The recent data reflects that this trend has accelerated in 2026. Credit against jewellery by NBFCs, including housing finance companies, has increased to 68.5% year-on-year in July 2026 as compared to 43.9% in the previous year. Bank credit against gold jewellery also increased by 88.1% year-on-year. At the end of July, outstanding gold-backed credit was around Rs. 3.54 lakh crore for NBFCs and Rs. 5.52 lakh crore for banks. Gold loans were also amongst the fastest-growing retail loan categories for NBFCs during the month. Rising Gold Prices have Increased Borrowing CapacityOne of the major reasons behind the surge is the high increase in gold prices. Domestic gold prices were very high in 2026 compared to the previous year. During Q2 2026, India's domestic gold price rose by 59% compared to the previous year, despite price easing from its earlier peaks. This played an important role in increasing the demand for gold loans. The amount you can borrow against gold jewellery depends partly on the gold value and applicable loan-to-value (LTV) limit. With a rise in gold prices, you can get a loan of a higher amount with the same quantity of gold. People Don't have to Sell their Gold Indian families are deeply connected to their gold jewellery due to its financial and emotional value. By selling gold, you can get cash on an instant basis, but the asset is gone forever. A gold loan, however, works very differently. A borrower has to pledge the jewellery as collateral to get a loan. After the loan is repaid, the collateral is released and given back to the borrower. This can make gold loans quite attractive when people need funds for short-term needs like medical emergencies, education, business needs, or any other large expenditures. The trend is particularly notable as gold recycling has reduced despite being 60% higher YoY. Gold holders no longer want to sell their gold for cash and have increasingly opted for collateralised borrowing to monetise their holdings instead. Gold Loans Are Secured Another important reason for the growth in gold loans is their secured nature. A gold loan is backed by physical gold pledged with the lender. This is quite different from a personal loan where there is no asset involved. Collateral gives extra security to lenders against probable repayment concerns. It also helps borrowers to get credit by using an asset they already own. This is quite helpful for those individuals who don't have a strong credit history or for those who find unsecured borrowing quite expensive. Banks are Increasing their Presence Gold lending was previously an important business for specialised NBFCs. But over time, things have changed, and now even banks are increasingly participating in this segment. The recent data shows that bank lending against gold jewellery has increased very fast, with outstanding credit reaching approximately Rs. 5.52 lakh crore by July 2026. Earlier, at the end of May 2026, the outstanding gold loans stood at around Rs. 5.1 lakh crore for banks, which reflected 105% YOY growth. Unsecured Lending is Being Watched Closely The rise in gold loans should also be viewed against the broader changes that are occurring in India's retail credit market. The RBI has brought certain measures in recent years for strengthening risk management around unsecured consumer credit. As lenders start focusing on risks associated with unsecured borrowing, secured products can become an important part of their lending strategy. This never means that people are not taking online loans or other unsecured credit. But the rise in gold loans shows that both lenders and borrowers are increasingly using existing assets to access funds. RBI Has Standardised Gold Loan Rules The rapid expansion in gold-backed lending has also been accompanied by a stronger regulatory framework. top_news.summary: Himachal Pradesh BJP president Rajeev Bindal on Monday accused Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu of misrepresenting facts about the Kishau Multipurpose Project and claimed that the Centre under Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah deserved credit for resolving the long-pending inter-state project. Bindal said the agreement for the project on the Tons River involved six states and had become possible after the Centre agreed to bear 90 per cent of the cost of its water component. The agreement for the Kishau Multipurpose Project involving six states has happened after the persistent efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. We thank both of them for making this agreement possible, Bindal told ANI. The Rs 15,624-crore Kishau project, proposed on the Tons river along the Himachal Pradesh-Uttarakhand border, is a 422-MW multipurpose project. The Centre has announced that 90 per cent of the cost of the water component will be provided as central assistance, while the remaining 10 per cent will be shared by the participating states. Bindal said the Centre's decision in 2025 to bear 90 per cent of the water-component cost was the key factor that enabled the agreement to move forward. The water component is the biggest component of this project, and 90 per cent of its cost is being borne by the Central Government. This decision was taken by the Modi government, and because of this decision the entire agreement could become successful, he said. He alleged that the state government was attempting to take credit for a project that had remained pending for decades. The Chief Minister is only trying to mislead the people by twisting and presenting the facts. The credit for this project goes to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and the Central Government, Bindal said. The BJP leader also questioned the decision under which Himachal Pradesh's share of water from the project would be allocated to Delhi and Rajasthan in return for these states sharing the cost of Himachal Pradesh's portion of the power component. The Centre had earlier confirmed that consensus was reached to allocate Himachal Pradesh's water share to Delhi and Rajasthan in return for sharing the cost of the state's power component. articles.title: National Health Leaders Call for Coordinated Action to Accelerate Cervical Cancer Elimination in India
articles.summary: India's pathway towards cervical cancer elimination requires more than screening and vaccination alone. It calls for accessible technologies, reliable treatment pathways, sustained financing, and coordinated action across government, healthcare, research, industry, and communities. This was the central message emerging from a two-day national dialogue series held on 15 and 16 September 2026, bringing together stakeholders from medical societies, public health, research, government, technology, international organisations, and civil society to build consensus on accelerating cervical cancer elimination in India. Organised by Cancer Awareness Prevention and Early Detection (CAPED) Trust, in collaboration with NCI-AIIMS, ICMR-NICPR, with the Cervical Cancer Elimination Consortium-India (CCEC-I) as a supporting partner, the first day was a dialogue on strengthening HPV DNA-based screening, improving access to treatment, expanding vaccination. The second day was a national high-level round table organized by CAPED, the Global HPV Consortium (GHC), and CCEC-I, to create a call to action translating national policy into action at the state and community level. The dialogue brought together several distinguished experts and stakeholders, including Shri. Pushpendra Rajput, Joint Secretary, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India; Dr. Shalini Singh, Dr. Showket Hussain, and Dr. Ruchika Gupta from ICMR-NICPR, New Delhi; Dr. Radhika A.G. from the Directorate of Family Welfare, New Delhi; Sripriya Rao (Co-Founder & Chief Growth Officer, Karkinos Healthcare); Dr. Neerja Bhatla, Professor & Ex-HOD, Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology and Professor Emeritus, National Cancer Institute-AIIMS, New Delhi; Dr. Pranay Tanwar, Dr. Seema Singhal, and Dr. Hari Sagiraju from NCI-AIIMS; Dr. Saritha ShyamSundar, HOD, Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi; Prof. Karen Canfell, (Cancer Elimination Collaboration, University of Sydney, and Lead, Elimination Partnership in Cervical Cancer (EPICC); Prof. Sanjay Dhir from IIT Delhi; and many other respected experts and stakeholders. articles.title: White Pine Copper Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study to Revive One of America
articles.summary: Post-Tax NPV8% of US$1.38 Billion and 23.1% IRR Position White Pine North as a Major New Source of Domestic Copper Supply and Regional Jobs KEY PFS HIGHLIGHTS Post-tax net present value ("NPV") at an 8% discount rate of US$1,376.9 million and internal rate of return ("IRR") of 23.1%; pre-tax NPV8%of US$1,783.1 million and IRR of 26.2%. Post-tax payback period of 3.4 years from the start of production; and pre-tax payback period of 3.1 years. Initial capital cost of US$905.5 million, representing a post-tax NPV-to-initial-capex ratio of approximately 1.5x. Mineral Resource Estimate of 191.2 million tonnes at 1.62% copper (Indicated: 169.1 Mt at 1.64% Cu and 20.66 g/t Ag; Inferred: 22.1 Mt at 1.51% Cu and 22.66 g/t Ag) Mineral Resources are reported inclusive of Mineral Reserves. Mineral Reserves are derived from the Indicated Mineral Resource after application of the relevant mining and economic factors. Reserve-supported, 26 year mine plan: probable Mineral Reserve of 137.9 million tonnes; steady-state production of 5.4 million ore tonnes per year and more than 45,000 tonnes of payable copper per year. No Inferred Mineral Resources are included in the PFS economic analysis. By-product cash cost of US$1.44/lb copper and all-in sustaining cost of US$2.32/lb copper. White Pine Copper's estimated steady-state AISC, normalized to Wood Mackenzie's 2026 cost curve assumptions, falls within the first quartile of the US subset of the Copper Cost Curve. Brownfield restart, and planned reuse of existing tailings storage infrastructure in Michigan's historic White Pine copper district, which produced approximately 4.5 billion pounds of copper between 1953 and 1995. All major permit applications have been submitted for review by the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy ("EGLE"). Conventional modified room-and-pillar underground mining and a conventional crush-grind-flotation plant, with copper and silver recoveries of 85.6% and 96.0%, respectively, into a clean, low-penalty concentrate yielding 26.2% copper and 451 g/t silver. WPC targets a Final Investment Decision in the second half of 2027 and commercial production in 2030. TORONTO and WHITE PINE, Mich., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- White Pine Copper LLC ("WPC" or the "Company"), a Michigan-based copper development company wholly owned by Kinterra Copper USA LLC("Kinterra"), is pleased to announce the results of a Pre-Feasibility Study ("PFS") for its White Pine North Project ("White Pine North" or the "Project") located in Michigan, USA. All dollar amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated. The PFS outlines a technically and economically robust plan to redevelop the historic White Pine copper district as a modern underground mining operation. The plan is supported by an extensive drilling database, a Probable Mineral Reserve, positive metallurgical testwork, and a well-established, state-only permitting framework. Copper was added to the U.S. Geological Survey's Critical Minerals List for the first time in 2025, as net U.S. import reliance for refined copper has climbed above 40% of consumption. Demand for copper in the United States is expected to grow substantially over the coming decade, driven by electrification, grid modernization and the build-out of domestic manufacturing capacity. White Pine North would rank among the largest new sources of domestically mined copper in the country, and its redevelopment is expected to bring significant employment and economic activity back to a part of Michigan's Upper Peninsula that has experienced sustained economic decline since the historic White Pine Mine closed in 1995. MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY "White Pine North is exactly the kind of asset the U.S. copper market needs right now: a large, high-grade deposit in one of the best-understood copper districts in North America, with a clear and capital-efficient path to production. Domestic demand for copper is climbing at the same time domestic supply has been shrinking, and we believe White Pine North can become one of the largest new sources of American-mined copper." said Cheryl Brandon, Co-Founder of Kinterra. "This PFS is the product of an integrated technical program across resource definition, mine engineering, metallurgy and permitting, and it confirms what this district has always offered: a large, well-understood orebody that modern mining methods can extract efficiently. Just as important, it means jobs and economic activity coming back to a part of Michigan's Upper Peninsula that has waited a long time for it."said Chad Wolahan, Project Director at White Pine Copper LLC. MINERAL RESOURCE AND RESERVE The current Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") was prepared by Dahrouge Geological Consulting USA Ltd. ("Dahrouge") using a validated drillhole, geological, analytical and density database current as of June 5, 2026, and is reported at a cut-off grade of 0.90% Cu: Indicated: 169.1 Mt at 1.64% Cu and 20.66 g/t Ag, containing 2.77 Mt of copper Inferred: 22.1 Mt at 1.51% Cu and 22.66 g/t Ag, containing 0.33 Mt of copper Total: 191.2 Mt at 1.62% Cu and 20.89 g/t Ag, containing 3.11 Mt of copper This current MRE supersedes all prior historical estimates for the Project, including the 1995 CRC estimate and the 2019 and 2023 G Mining Services Inc. estimates, none of which should be relied upon. The Mineral Reserve, effective July 16, 2026, is classified entirely as Probable and totals 137.9 million tonnes at 1.04% Cu and 16.02 g/t Ag, containing approximately 3,171 million pounds of copper and 71.0 million ounces of silver. The Reserve reflects a net smelter return cut-off grade specific to each mining area and an estimated mining dilution of 6% by volume at 100% mining recovery. PFS RESULTS SHOW ROBUST ECONOMICS The PFS financial model was developed on a 100%-equity, 100%-ownership basis with no financing costs assumed, applying long-term consensus commodity price assumptions of US$4.97/lb copper and US$53.69/oz silver and an 8% discount rate. Summary Financial Metrics Post-tax NPV (8% discount rate): US$1,376.9 million Post-tax IRR: 23.1% Post-tax payback period: approximately 3.4 years Pre-tax NPV (8% discount rate): US$1,783.1 million Pre-tax IRR: 26.2% Pre-tax payback period: approximately 3.1 years Initial capital cost: US$905.5 million Sustaining capital cost: US$863.0 million Closure capital cost: US$160.0 million Life-of-mine operating cost: US$5,952 million (or US$43.16 per tonne processed) By-product cash cost: US$1.44/lb Cu; by-product all-in sustaining cost ("AISC"): US$2.32/lb Cu Co-product cash cost: US$2.15/lb CuEq; co-product AISC: US$2.85/lb CuEq Mine life: 26 years Sensitivity analysis indicates the Project's economics are most sensitive to metal price, head grade and recovery, and less sensitive to operating and initial capital costs. MINE PLAN AND DEVELOPMENT White Pine North will be mined using a modified room-and-pillar method with no backfill, well suited to the deposit's relatively flat-lying geometry and enabling high equipment utilization and predictable production rates. The mine is designed for steady-state production of 15,000 tonnes per day (5.4 Mt/y), accessed via declines expanding from two to four over the life of mine, with ore delivered to surface via a truck-and-conveyor material handling system. Over the life of mine, total ore mined is estimated at 137.9 Mt at an average grade of 1.04% Cu, containing approximately 3,171 million pounds of copper. METALLURGY AND PROCESSING Metallurgical testwork completed between 2024 and 2026 at Intertek's Base Metals Laboratory in Kamloops, BC, supports a conventional processing route comprising crushing, SAG and ball mill grinding, gravity concentration, and flotation. The process is expected to achieve copper and silver recoveries of 85.6% and 96.0%, respectively, producing a clean copper concentrate grading approximately 26.2% Cu and 451 g/t Ag, with low deleterious-element content. PERMITTING AND LOCATION White Pine North is located in Ontonagon County in Michigan's Upper Peninsula, within the historic White Pine copper district, which produced approximately 4.5 billion pounds of copper between 1953 and 1995 before operations were suspended. The Project is a brownfield redevelopment that will reuse the site's existing tailings storage infrastructure, reducing its environmental footprint relative to a greenfield development. All major permit applications have been submitted for regulatory review and fall under the jurisdiction of the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes and Energypursuant to the Michigan Natural Resources and Environmental Protection Act. The Project requires no federal permits as it involves no federal lands, minerals, or other nexus that would trigger the National Environmental Policy Act. All baseline environmental, archeological and hydrogeological studies have been completed and WPC has engaged with local governments, community groups and Native American communities throughout Project development. PROJECT SCHEDULE WPC has commenced a Feasibility Study targeted for completion by mid-2027, with a Final Investment Decision targeted for H2 2027 and commercial production targeted for 2030, reflecting an estimated 30-month construction period following Final Investment Decision. ABOUT WHITE PINE COPPER LLC White Pine Copper LLC is a Michigan-based copper development company advancing the White Pine North Project in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. www.whitepinecu.com. ABOUT KINTERRA CAPITAL Kinterra Capital is a private equity firm that invests in the people, ideas, critical materials, and strategic infrastructure necessary to accelerate the development of the modern economy. With nearly 20 years of mining investment experience, Kinterra leverages significant domain specific technical and transactional expertise to source and manage investments that create value for its stakeholders, all while supporting the communities within which we operate through meaningful partnerships. At Kinterra, we focus on creative ideation, rigorous analysis and executing with excellence to make investments that will create sustainable, strong and secure supply chains. For more information about Kinterra Capital, please visit www.kinterracapital.com. TECHNICAL CONSULTANTS The scientific and technical information in this press release relating to the MRE is based on, and fairly represents, information prepared under the supervision of Paul Richardson, M.Sc., RM-SME, an employee of Dahrouge, which is independent of the Company. Mr. Richardson is a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101 and has reviewed and approved the mineral resource information contained in this press release. The technical data, engineering designs, and cost estimates supporting the Pre-Feasibility Study were prepared by experienced, independent consulting firms under the oversight of the Company and relevant subject matter experts. The consulting firms and their respective areas of contribution to the Pre-Feasibility Study are outlined below. Ausenco Engineering Canada ULC: Process flowsheet, process plant and surface ancillary infrastructure design; overall cost estimates, financial model and PFS compilation. Dahrouge Geological Consulting USA Ltd.:Geology modeling and MRE. Foth Infrastructure & Environment, LLC:Environmental studies and permitting, water balance and water management. Stantec Consulting Services Inc.:Underground mine design and engineering, including the mine planning and modifying factors used to support declaration of the Probable Mineral Reserve. WSP USA Inc.: Underground geotechnical programs and design criteria. Tetra Tech, Inc.: Tailings disposal facilities design and hydrology modeling. SRK Consulting (U.S.), Inc.: Geochemical programs. Paterson & Cooke USA, Ltd.:Tailings thickening and tailings pumping systems. CAUTIONARY NOTE REGARDING THE PRE-FEASIBILITY STUDY The PFS is preliminary in nature. articles.summary: The Indian Micro-Fertilizers Manufacturers Association (IMMA) has called for a "One Nation, One License" digital framework for fertilizer licensing, freer exports of non-subsidised Made-in-India specialty fertilizers and micronutrients, and a uniform 5% GST for all FCO-notified plant nutrition products. Industry-government roundtable discusses digital licensing, FCO reforms, export facilitation, anti-counterfeiting and GST rationalisation. The proposals were discussed at the 3rd IMMA Industry-Government Roundtable held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, which brought together senior Government representatives and stakeholders from the micronutrient, specialty fertilizer and plant nutrition industry. The deliberations focused on ease of doing business and regulatory reforms, export facilitation and global market access, and GST rationalisation, with industry and Government representatives discussing specific measures that could be taken forward through evidence-backed submissions. 'One Nation, One License' digital framework proposed Opening the first session, Dr Rahul Mirchandani, President, IMMA, urged the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare to consider developing a national digital fertilizer licensing data stack to simplify the process of obtaining and renewing manufacturing licences and state marketing permissions. Under the proposed framework, manufacturers could upload corporate, manufacturing, product, technical, statutory and other licence-related documents once on a secure national digital platform. After digital verification by the competent authorities, the authenticated documents could be used for applications across states instead of companies repeatedly submitting the same documents. articles.title: Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus Now Open - 미주 한국일보
articles.summary: • Six-Building Expansion Brings Specialized Hospital and Outpatient Care Together on One Integrated Campus • Dedicated Cancer, Women’s Health, Digestive Health and Surgical Facilities Expand Access to Advanced Care in Orange County IRVINE, Calif. (Sept. 21, 2026) – Hoag today announced the opening of the Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus, a major expansion that brings specialized hospitals, outpatient facilities, advanced surgical services and nationally recognized clinical programs together on one integrated campus in Irvine.“This expansion is more than a collection of state-of-the-art buildings. It reflects Hoag’s commitment to growing alongside Orange County, while continuing to redefine what healthcare can look like,” said Robert T. Braithwaite, President & CEO of Hoag. “The Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus was envisioned as a healthcare village, bringing specialized care and clinical expertise together in a place where every aspect of the patient experience was designed to make care more connected, more convenient, and more personalized.”A New Chapter in IrvineHoag Hospital Irvine first opened in 2010, extending Hoag’s hospital-based care into one of Orange County’s fastest-growing communities. In the years since, Hoag has continued to expand its presence in Irvine alongside the community it serves, adding new services, specialists and facilities to meet growing and increasingly complex healthcare needs.The opening of the Sun Family Campus marks the next chapter in that evolution, building on Hoag Hospital Irvine’s strong foundation with a significant expansion of advanced specialty care. The campus brings together dedicated facilities for cancer, women’s health, digestive health and advanced surgery, along with emergency and orthopedic care. Across Sand Canyon Avenue, additional Hoag outpatient facilities offer primary care, urgent care, imaging, physician offices and specialty services, creating a connected destination where patients can access care across a broad range of needs.Designed Around PatientsThe campus was designed to make that care easier to navigate and the experience of receiving it less stressful. Hospital and outpatient services are connected to reduce friction as patients move through diagnosis, treatment and recovery, while the physical environment reflects the same attention to the patient experience.Natural light, landscaped outdoor spaces, intuitive wayfinding, welcoming gathering areas and amenities for patients and families are integrated throughout the campus to promote comfort, connection and healing. Together with a care model that brings specialists and services closer to patients, these elements create an environment designed around both the clinical and human needs of patients and families.“We had the rare opportunity to build around the patient experience from the ground up,” said Robert Brunswick, Chair of the Hoag Hospital Board of Directors. “That meant thinking not only about the medicine and technology inside these buildings, but also about how patients and families move through them, how they stay connected to their care teams, and how the environment itself can support them during some of the most important moments of their lives.”Women’s HealthHoag’s new Women’s Hospital and Women’s Outpatient Pavilion bring together specialized care for women across every stage of life, from pregnancy and childbirth to breast health, gynecology, menopause and wellness.The Women’s Hospital features 24 private labor, delivery and postpartum suites, a 24/7 OB Emergency Department and a 17-bed Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) with private rooms designed to support families. Just steps away, the Women’s Outpatient Pavilion provides breast health, maternal-fetal diagnostics, OB-GYN and midwifery care, advanced imaging and wellness services, connecting care across different stages of a woman’s life.Cancer CareHoag’s cancer facilities bring specialized hospital and outpatient care together to make a complex cancer journey more coordinated and convenient. The Cancer Outpatient Pavilion brings oncology specialists, infusion therapy, imaging, pharmacy and supportive services together in one location, while a Cancer Hospital just steps away provides dedicated inpatient rooms for patients undergoing cancer treatment.The campus is also home to Orange County’s first dedicated Cancer Urgent Care, providing evaluation and treatment for cancer-related symptoms and therapy-related side effects. Available to both Hoag and non-Hoag cancer patients, the service gives patients another option for timely, specialized care outside of a traditional emergency department.Digestive HealthHoag’s digestive health facilities bring together specialized physicians, advanced diagnostics, procedures and hospital care for patients with digestive conditions, creating a more connected path from diagnosis through treatment and recovery.The Digestive Outpatient Pavilion features six specialized procedure suites supporting advanced digestive health and interventional pulmonology care, with technology for minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment. From routine screenings to highly specialized procedures, these spaces allow physicians to identify and treat conditions while helping many patients recover more comfortably and return home the same day. Meanwhile, the adjacent Digestive Hospital provides dedicated rooms and specialized care teams for patients who need hospital-based care.Advanced Surgical ServicesThe Surgical Pavilion expands Hoag’s capabilities for complex surgery and critical care with eight state-of-the-art operating rooms, including a hybrid suite for highly complex cardiovascular and vascular procedures; advanced robotic-assisted technology; and minimally invasive surgical capabilities.The pavilion was designed to support coordination throughout the surgical experience, from preparation and surgery through recovery and critical care. Dedicated pre-operative and recovery areas, spacious intensive care rooms and amenities for families further reflect the campus’s focus on both clinical excellence and the patient experience.Community Investment Made Possible Through Philanthropy Philanthropy has been a cornerstone of Hoag’s growth since its earliest days, when community donations and a landmark gift from the Hoag family helped establish the flagship hospital in Newport Beach. Today, that tradition continues through the Boldly Hoag campaign, which fueled the expansion of the Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus. Thousands of community donors and partners have contributed to the expansion, along with transformational gifts that have accelerated the campus’s growth. These include $100 million from campus namesakes Diana and David Sun and $25 million from longtime Hoag supporters Benjamin and Carmela Du, whose gift established the Du Family Hospital Pavilion. “Philanthropy is one of the forces that makes Hoag’s privademic model possible, giving our physicians and clinical leaders the resources to move quickly, invest in innovation and build programs around what patients need,” said Caroline A. Pereira, MBA, president of the Hoag Hospital Foundation. “The Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus is an extraordinary example of what can happen when a community invests in its own health. Every donor who contributed to this vision helped create a place that will serve Orange County families for generations.”Hoag Hospital Irvine Sun Family Campus at a Glance• $1 billion expansion • The expansion adds six new buildings to the hospital campus. • The expansion adds 155 inpatient beds to the campus, bringing the hospital’s total bed count to 251.• The expansion adds 11 operating rooms and two procedure rooms. • The expansion includes 120,000 square feet of ambulatory facilities • The project brings dedicated cancer, women’s health, digestive health and augmented surgical facilities to the campus.• The expansion builds upon the hospital’s existing 24/7 Emergency Department, inpatient medical care, and Hoag Orthopedic Institute, a nationally recognized orthopedic specialty hospital.• The Sun Family Campus includes Orange County’s first dedicated Cancer Urgent Care. • The new Women’s Hospital includes a 24/7 OB Emergency Department.• A 17-bed Level III NICU is part of the expansionABOUT HOAGHoag is a nonprofit, regional healthcare delivery system in Orange County, California. Delivering world-class, comprehensive, personalized care, Hoag consists of 1,800 top physicians, 17 urgent care facilities, 13 health & wellness centers, and two award-winning hospitals. Hoag offers a comprehensive blend of healthcare services that includes seven institutes providing specialized services in the following areas: cancer, digestive health, heart and vascular, neurosciences, spine, women’s health, and orthopedics through Hoag’s affiliate, Hoag Orthopedic Institute, which consists of an orthopedic hospital and five ambulatory surgical centers. Hoag is consistently named a best hospital by U.S. News & World Report, and is a designated Magnet® with Distinction hospital by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). For more information, visit hoag.org.

articles.title: "BJP's Punjab conspiracy exposed": Sanjay Singh alleges drug trafficker Jagga was called 'Bhai' by BJP, being portrayed as revolutionary
articles.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party on Monday alleged a conspiracy by the BJP, Shiromani Akali Dal and Congress to defame Punjab and undermine the Bhagwant Mann government's campaign against drugs. Senior party leader and Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh said Jagga Singh, whom the BJP has referred to as its bhai, has nine cases registered against him, including under the NDPS (Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances) Act, while eight cases are registered against Mohan Jeet Singh. Addressing a press conference at the AAP headquarters on Monday, Singh said that the BJP, Congress and Akali Dal are jointly hatching a deep conspiracy in Punjab. A complete conspiracy is being planned to defame the campaign being run by CM Bhagwant Mann and the AAP government against drugs in Punjab, weaken it, stop it, and ensure that Punjab is defamed across the world for drugs, he added. The AAP MP added, There are three characters in this conspiracy, Jagga Singh, Mohanjeet Singh and Gulzar Singh. The Congress, BJP and Akali Dal, without knowing the truth or conducting any investigation, are using these people and standing behind them to make bizarre statements and run campaigns against the AAP government. Sanjay Singh said that Jagga Singh, whom the BJP and Congress are presenting as a revolutionary and claiming was running a campaign against drugs and was forced to consume poison as a result, has nine cases registered against him. Jagga Singh has already been convicted in four of these nine cases, and cases of rape, kidnapping and drug trafficking are also registered against him, he added. He continued, Two gram panchayats had formally passed resolutions against drugs, because his business was unable to operate, as he himself had been involved in the drug trade. The Congress, BJP and Akali Dal are portraying him as a revolutionary and claiming that the government is harassing him. The AAP MP highlighted that the second person is Mohanjeet Singh, who had shown a black flag to Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. He said the Congress, BJP and Akali Dal are running a campaign claiming that this warrior fighting against drugs was brutally beaten merely for showing a black flag. The reality, he said, is that eight FIRs are registered against Mohanjeet Singh. The third name is Gulzar, about whom it was claimed that he took his own life because of Minister Harpal Singh Cheema. The reality is that opposition parties in Punjab kept making Gulzar record videos and drove him around in a car until he made a statement against the AAP. In the first video Gulzar recorded, he did not mention Harpal Singh Cheema or the AAP. However, in a subsequent video, he named Harpal Singh Cheema. This shows that opposition parties pressured and used him, which led to his present condition, Singh said. He said, I want to tell the Congress, BJP and Akali Dal not to indulge in such filthy politics and not to try to defame Punjab by making baseless and false allegations. The AAP government is running its campaign against drugs with complete commitment and is eliminating drugs. Sanjay Singh said that he was also aware of the period when drug mafias had links with leaders of the Akali Dal and BJP. He said the Akali Dal, BJP and Congress had together conducted the drug trade in Punjab and committed the sin of delivering drugs to every village. Sanjay Singh claimed that under the rule of these parties, the drug trade continued to flourish and governments provided protection to drug dealers. Punjab has also witnessed a period when, under the Akali Dal-BJP government, young children studying in high school and intermediate classes died because of drugs, he added. Drugs worth Rs 20,000 crore were seized at Adani's Mundra Port in BJP-ruled Gujarat. This was stated by the central government agency NIA. The NIA had approached the Supreme Court to oppose the bail of those arrested in connection with the drug trade. While opposing their bail, the NIA stated in an affidavit that the money from the drugs worth Rs 20,000 crore seized at Adani's port in Gujarat was spent on training terrorists in Pakistan, Singh said. The NIA has submitted a written affidavit before the Supreme Court opposing bail for the accused, stating that they should not be granted bail because they were very serious criminals and the money from the drugs was being used to train terrorists in Pakistan, the MP added. He noted, Gujarat has a liquor ban and alcohol is completely prohibited there, yet 100 people died after consuming poisonous liquor, while PM Narendra Modi and Nitin Nabin did not utter a single word. In neighbouring Uttar Pradesh, 105 people died after consuming poisonous liquor in Aligarh, but not a single BJP leader said a word. Therefore, he said, BJP leaders should not try to defame Punjab, because the entire country knows them and they will be exposed across the country. Singh concluded by highlighting that the Akali Dal, BJP and Congress have themselves run the largest drug trade in Punjab. If any party has genuinely taken action against it, he said, it is the AAP and the Bhagwant Mann government. If these parties want to speak openly about this issue, we will do so, but we will not allow them to defame Punjab. Those who themselves are disgraced and against whom cases of rape, kidnapping and drug trafficking are registered are being used by these parties for politics, with the parties standing behind them, he said. (ANI)

articles.title: Gold Loans on the Rise as Indians Increasingly Borrow Against Gold
articles.summary: For many years, gold has held important value as a store of wealth among Indian families. But with changing times, the mindset of people has changed. Due to which the, gold which was lying in lockers and cupboards has started being used to raise money. Gold loans are seeing rapid growth in India as there has been an increase in borrowers pledging jewellery to meet the funding requirements instead of selling it. The recent data reflects that this trend has accelerated in 2026. Credit against jewellery by NBFCs, including housing finance companies, has increased to 68.5% year-on-year in July 2026 as compared to 43.9% in the previous year. Bank credit against gold jewellery also increased by 88.1% year-on-year. At the end of July, outstanding gold-backed credit was around Rs. 3.54 lakh crore for NBFCs and Rs. 5.52 lakh crore for banks. Gold loans were also amongst the fastest-growing retail loan categories for NBFCs during the month. Rising Gold Prices have Increased Borrowing CapacityOne of the major reasons behind the surge is the high increase in gold prices. Domestic gold prices were very high in 2026 compared to the previous year. During Q2 2026, India's domestic gold price rose by 59% compared to the previous year, despite price easing from its earlier peaks. This played an important role in increasing the demand for gold loans. The amount you can borrow against gold jewellery depends partly on the gold value and applicable loan-to-value (LTV) limit. With a rise in gold prices, you can get a loan of a higher amount with the same quantity of gold. People Don't have to Sell their Gold Indian families are deeply connected to their gold jewellery due to its financial and emotional value. By selling gold, you can get cash on an instant basis, but the asset is gone forever. A gold loan, however, works very differently. A borrower has to pledge the jewellery as collateral to get a loan. After the loan is repaid, the collateral is released and given back to the borrower. This can make gold loans quite attractive when people need funds for short-term needs like medical emergencies, education, business needs, or any other large expenditures. The trend is particularly notable as gold recycling has reduced despite being 60% higher YoY. Gold holders no longer want to sell their gold for cash and have increasingly opted for collateralised borrowing to monetise their holdings instead. Gold Loans Are Secured Another important reason for the growth in gold loans is their secured nature. A gold loan is backed by physical gold pledged with the lender. This is quite different from a personal loan where there is no asset involved. Collateral gives extra security to lenders against probable repayment concerns. It also helps borrowers to get credit by using an asset they already own. This is quite helpful for those individuals who don't have a strong credit history or for those who find unsecured borrowing quite expensive. Banks are Increasing their Presence Gold lending was previously an important business for specialised NBFCs. But over time, things have changed, and now even banks are increasingly participating in this segment. The recent data shows that bank lending against gold jewellery has increased very fast, with outstanding credit reaching approximately Rs. 5.52 lakh crore by July 2026. Earlier, at the end of May 2026, the outstanding gold loans stood at around Rs. 5.1 lakh crore for banks, which reflected 105% YOY growth. Unsecured Lending is Being Watched Closely The rise in gold loans should also be viewed against the broader changes that are occurring in India's retail credit market. The RBI has brought certain measures in recent years for strengthening risk management around unsecured consumer credit. As lenders start focusing on risks associated with unsecured borrowing, secured products can become an important part of their lending strategy. This never means that people are not taking online loans or other unsecured credit. But the rise in gold loans shows that both lenders and borrowers are increasingly using existing assets to access funds. Bindal said the agreement for the project on the Tons River involved six states and had become possible after the Centre agreed to bear 90 per cent of the cost of its water component. The agreement for the Kishau Multipurpose Project involving six states has happened after the persistent efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. We thank both of them for making this agreement possible, Bindal told ANI. The Rs 15,624-crore Kishau project, proposed on the Tons river along the Himachal Pradesh-Uttarakhand border, is a 422-MW multipurpose project. The Centre has announced that 90 per cent of the cost of the water component will be provided as central assistance, while the remaining 10 per cent will be shared by the participating states. Bindal said the Centre's decision in 2025 to bear 90 per cent of the water-component cost was the key factor that enabled the agreement to move forward. The water component is the biggest component of this project, and 90 per cent of its cost is being borne by the Central Government. This decision was taken by the Modi government, and because of this decision the entire agreement could become successful, he said. He alleged that the state government was attempting to take credit for a project that had remained pending for decades. The Chief Minister is only trying to mislead the people by twisting and presenting the facts. The credit for this project goes to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and the Central Government, Bindal said.
